# Draft:Artifact Space

Artifact Space is a 2021 science fiction novel by Christian Cameron, writing under the pseudonym Miles Cameron. It is the first volume of the Arcana Imperii series, which follows the journey of an orphan who falsifies her identity to join the crew of a massive interstellar merchant vessel. The novel has been compared by critics to the Horatio Hornblower series in a space setting, noted for its blending of naval tradition with high-concept space opera.
Plot
The narrative centers on Marca Nbaro, an orphan raised in a bleak "mid-tier" block on Earth. Seeking to escape her circumstances, she uses her meager savings to purchase a fake identity and secure a position as a midshipman aboard the Athens. The ship is one of the "Greatships," massive, kilometer-long interstellar vessels owned by the Combined Greatships corporation.
The Athens is bound for "Artifact Space" to trade for "xenoglas," a mysterious and vital substance produced by an enigmatic alien species known as the "Starfish." As Nbaro navigates the rigid social and military hierarchy of the ship, she discovers that the Greatships are being targeted and destroyed by a cabal including a mysterious and technologically advanced predator species. The story follows her efforts to survive shipboard politics and combat while protecting the ship's vital trade mission.
World-building
The novel is set in a future governed by the Directorate of Human Corporations (DHC). The political system is depicted as a mercantile-socialist hybrid, where vast corporate interests manage human expansion across the Mediterranean Sea Complex, a series of trade routes connecting solar systems.
Unlike many works of contemporary science fiction that focus on transhumanism, Artifact Space emphasizes a "used future" aesthetic. The Greatships are described with a baroque level of detail, featuring murals, bronze fittings, and wooden panels alongside railguns and advanced FTL drives. The series' FTL concept, "Artifact Space," requires precise naval maneuvers, making the crew's discipline and tradition central to the ship's survival.
Arcana Imperii series
The universe, known as Arcana Imperii, includes direct sequels and supplementary short fiction.
* Artifact Space (2021): The debut novel establishing the Greatship Athens and protagonist Marca Nbaro.
* Beyond the Fringe: An Arcana Imperii Collection (2023): A collection of short stories and novelas providing historical and technical context for the Directorate of Human Corporations (DHC) and life aboard different vessels in the fleet.
* Deep Black (Upcoming): The direct sequel to Artifact Space, continuing Nbaro's service as the Greatships face an escalating interstellar threat. It is scheduled for a March 2026 release.
* Whalesong (Upcoming): Cameron has announced a third main novel in the sequence, which will focus on the wider conflict involving the alien predator species and the "Starfish."
Reception
Artifact Space received positive reviews for its realism and technical detail. The British Science Fiction Association (BSFA) compared Nbaro's journey to characters like Wesley Crusher, noting the clever re-mapping of real-world naval aviation procedures onto a detailed futuristic canvas.
Grimdark Magazine highlighted the author's background as a naval officer, noting that the combat and strategy felt grounded in authentic experience. The review specifically noted the Renaissance era sea trade inspiration.
Authors Alastair Reynolds and Peter F. Hamilton also provided praise; Hamilton stated the book captures what it will really be like serving aboard an armed interstellar merchant ship. Other critics described the world-building as thrilling and sublime, emphasizing the detailed realism of the shipboard environment.
